# WordCount Website

This is the source code for the WordCount website, built with [Zola](https://www.getzola.org/), a static site generator written in Rust.

**Documentation created:** December 14, 2024
**Generated by:** Cursor AI Assistant (Auto - agent router designed by Cursor)

> **Note:** This README and the initial project structure were generated using Cursor's AI coding assistant. The site uses Zola (v0.18.0+) for static site generation, with source files organized in the `src/` directory and build output in `public/`.

## Project Structure

```
.
```

## Prerequisites

You need to have [Zola](https://www.getzola.org/) installed on your system.

### Installing Zola

**macOS (using Homebrew):**
```bash
brew install zola
```

**Linux:**
```bash
# Download from https://github.com/getzola/zola/releases
# Or use your distribution's package manager
```

**Windows:**
Download the executable from [Zola releases](https://github.com/getzola/zola/releases)

**Using Cargo (if you have Rust installed):**
```bash
cargo install zola
```

## Building the Site

### Check Installation
```bash
make check
```

### Build for Production
```bash
make build
```

This will generate the static site in the `public/` directory.

### Serve Locally (Development)
```bash
make serve
```

This will start a local development server at `http://127.0.0.1:1111` that auto-reloads when you make changes.

**Note:** If images or CSS don't update after making changes, try:
- Hard refresh: `Cmd+Shift+R` (Mac) or `Ctrl+Shift+R` (Windows/Linux)
- Disable cache in browser DevTools (Network tab → "Disable cache")
- Restart the Zola server if issues persist

### Clean Build Artifacts
```bash
make clean
```

## Editing Content

### Pages
- **Home page**: Edit `src/content/_index.md`
- **About page**: Edit `src/content/about.md`
- **Terms**: Edit `src/content/terms.md`
- **Privacy**: Edit `src/content/privacy.md`

### Team Members
Edit `src/data/team.yaml` to add, remove, or modify team members. Each member should have:
- `name`: Full name
- `role`: Job title/role
- `image`: Path to image (relative to `static/`)
- `social`: Optional social links (email, github, twitter, linkedin, website)

Example:
```yaml
- name: "John Doe"
  role: "Senior Engineer"
  image: "/team/john_doe.jpg"
  social:
    email: "john@wordcount.solutions"
    github: "johndoe"
    website: "https://johndoe.com"
```

### Styling
Edit `src/static/css/main.css` to modify the site's appearance.

### Static Assets
All files in `src/static/` are copied directly to `public/` during the build process, preserving the directory structure. This includes:
- CSS files
- Images (photos, backgrounds, favicons)
- JavaScript files
- `.htaccess` files
- Any other static assets

You can organize files in subdirectories within `src/static/` (e.g., `src/static/images/`, `src/static/js/`) and they will maintain the same structure in `public/`.

### Templates
Edit files in `src/templates/` to change the HTML structure and layout.

## Deployment

The site is automatically built and deployed via GitHub Actions. When you push to the repository, the workflow will:
1. Build the site using Zola
2. Deploy to Dreamhost via rsync

See `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` for the deployment configuration.

### Manual Deployment

To deploy manually:

```bash
make build
rsync -avz --delete public/ WordCountwebmaster@wordcount.solutions:/wordcount.solutions/
```

Note: The build output goes to `public/` at the root level, even though Zola runs from `src/`.

## Design Notes

- **Home page**: Full-screen background with centered text
- **Other pages**: Cream background with rust-colored border frame, background image in upper-right corner
- **Navigation**: Top navigation bar with links to Home, Team, and About
- **Footer**: Links to Terms and Privacy (white text)
- **Team page**: Grid of cards with circular profile images
